title: Cold Call
developer: Christian Cook, Jake Roberts, Jaimie Pangan, Jonathan Davies
shortDescription: Collect horrific creatures by solving puzzles in this unsettling story about Simon grieving for his slain family and taking vengeance on the monsters responsible.

summary.result: A cohesive narrative experience that creates an unsettling atmosphere and leverages gameplay as a storytelling device.

title: Down the Count
developer: Sarah Mak, Solomon, Natalie Wong, & Associates
shortDescription: Cause as much chaos as you possibly can before the timer runs out! Play as the disgruntled servant of Count Dawn during the annual vampire CountCon, and use your knowledge of vampire weaknesses to take them down.

summary.teamSize: 16 (5 programmers, 8 artists, 1 composer, 1 sound designer, 1 writer)
summary.result: A fun, chaotic physics sim where the AI takes a prominent role in influencing the feel of gameplay

title: Lost & Found
developer: Christian Cook, Franco Reviglio, Jonathan Davies, neoNote, & buckstrom
shortDescription: The call to adventure awaits! You are a daring rescue pilot in a wonderous archipelago of unique and interesting islands. Intercept distress signals from stranded travelers, and use the clues they give to figure out where they are on the island. Pay close attention to what they say! You only have so much fuel and can't check everywhere...

summary.result: A finished and well polished game incorporating all aspects of the team's contributions

title: The Subtle Art of Giving a Duck
shortDescription: Work together to platform your way through the mountain, giving up your precious abilities to those who need them so that you all may come to a better place.

title: Pick Your Poison
shortDescription: A point-and-click game that balances strategy and chance as you face off against an ominous bartender gambling for your life. Take turns drinking from potentially poisoned glasses while trying to sabotage your opponent.

title: Flint's Hints
shortDescription: Flint's Hints is a point-and-click puzzle game inspired by escape room mechanics. You are directly presented with the prompt to explore the house and fulfill 3 requests made by your pet cat, Flint. You must use context clues in the environment to determine what the requests are and how to fulfill them. Along the way, you may uncover other clues seemingly unrelated to your tasks. It is up to you whether you want to investigate further or not.

title: The Boys
shortDescription: Your friends challenge you to stay at the creepy old house at the edge of town. It's been abandoned for decades, but many suspect that horrible spirits linger inside. Armed with nothing but your flashlight and your wits, will you face the trials inside? Can you overcome the obstacles in your way? Are you brave enough to face 'The Boys'?
